passages.scripture: Behold what manner of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God. And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know Him.

lines.text: Look at the love God the Father has given us!
And how great that love is!
God even calls us His children!
And that is exactly what we are — God's true children!
The world — everyone living apart from God — does not know us.
This is because the world never knew God.

passages.scripture: Beloved, we are now children of God, and what we will be has not yet been revealed. We know that when Christ appears, we will be like Him, for we will see Him as He is.

lines.text: Dear friends, we are already children of God.
But what we will become has not yet been shown to us.
When Christ appears, we know we will be like Him.
For we will see Him — Jesus — just as He truly is.

passages.scripture: And everyone who has this hope in Him purifies himself, just as Christ is pure.

lines.text: This hope is ours: one day we will be like Christ.
Anyone — any of us — who holds this hope in Christ purifies himself, just as Christ is pure.

passages.scripture: Everyone who practices sin practices lawlessness as well. Indeed, sin is lawlessness.

lines.text: Anyone who keeps sinning is also breaking God's law.
In fact, sin is lawlessness: breaking God's law.

passages.scripture: But you know that Christ appeared to take away sins, and in Him there is no sin.

lines.text: But you know that Christ appeared to take away sins.
And in Christ there is no sin.

passages.scripture: No one who remains in Him keeps on sinning. No one who continues to sin has seen Him or known Him.

lines.text: No one who remains joined to Christ keeps on sinning.
No one who keeps on sinning has ever seen Christ.
No one who keeps on sinning has ever known Christ, either.

passages.scripture: Little children, let no one deceive you: The one who practices righteousness is righteous, just as Christ is righteous.

lines.text: Dear children, do not let anyone deceive you.
Anyone — any of us — who does what is right is righteous, just as Christ is righteous.

passages.scripture: The one who practices sin is of the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the very start. This is why the Son of God was revealed, to destroy the works of the devil.

lines.text: Anyone who keeps on sinning belongs to the devil.
For the devil has been sinning from the very beginning.
This is why the Son of God appeared: to destroy the works of the devil.

passages.scripture: Anyone born of God refuses to practice sin, because God’s seed abides in him; he cannot go on sinning, because he has been born of God.

lines.text: Anyone born of God is a child of God.
And God's seed — His own life — abides in God's children.
So anyone born of God does not keep on sinning.
Indeed, a child of God cannot keep on sinning.

passages.scripture: By this the children of God are distinguished from the children of the devil: Anyone who does not practice righteousness is not of God, nor is anyone who does not love his brother.

lines.text: God has children.
The devil also has children.
We can tell who belongs to God and who belongs to the devil.
Anyone who does not do what is right does not belong to God.
Anyone who does not love his brother does not belong to God, either.

passages.scripture: This is the message you have heard from the beginning: We should love one another.

lines.text: We should love one another.
This is the message.
You have heard this message from the beginning.

passages.scripture: Do not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and murdered his brother. And why did Cain slay him? Because his own deeds were evil, while those of his brother were righteous.

lines.text: Do not be like Cain.
Cain belonged to the evil one.
Cain murdered his brother.
Why did Cain kill his brother?
Cain killed his brother because his own deeds were evil.
But Cain's brother's deeds were righteous.

passages.scripture: So do not be surprised, brothers, if the world hates you.

lines.text: The world may hate you.
So do not be surprised, brothers and sisters.

passages.scripture: We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love our brothers. The one who does not love remains in death.

lines.text: We love our brothers and sisters.
So we know we have passed from death to life.
The one who does not love remains in death.

passages.scripture: Everyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that eternal life does not reside in a murderer.

lines.text: Everyone who hates his brother or sister is a murderer.
You know that eternal life does not remain in a murderer.

passages.scripture: If anyone with earthly possessions sees his brother in need, but withholds his compassion from him, how can the love of God abide in him?

lines.text: Suppose someone has earthly possessions.
Suppose this person sees his brother or sister in need.
But suppose this person closes his heart to his brother or sister.
How can God's love remain in a heart closed to a brother or sister in need?

passages.scripture: Little children, let us love not in word and speech, but in action and truth.

lines.text: Little children, let us love.
Let us not love only in word and speech.
But rather let us love in action and truth.

passages.scripture: By this we know what love is: Jesus laid down His life for us, and we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers.

lines.text: Jesus laid down His life for us.
Jesus' sacrifice is how we know what love is.
So we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers and sisters.

passages.scripture: And by this we will know that we belong to the truth, and will assure our hearts in His presence: Even if our hearts condemn us, God is greater than our hearts, and He knows all things.

lines.text: By our love, we know that we belong to the truth.
Our love will calm our hearts in God's presence.
Even if our hearts condemn us, God is greater than our hearts.
And God knows all things.

passages.scripture: Beloved, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before God, and we will receive from Him whatever we ask, because we keep His commandments and do what is pleasing in His sight.

lines.text: Beloved, suppose we keep God's commandments.
Suppose we do what pleases God.
And suppose our hearts do not condemn us.
Then we have confidence before God.
And we will receive from God whatever we ask.

passages.scripture: And this is His commandment: that we should believe in the name of His Son, Jesus Christ, and we should love one another just as He commanded us.

lines.text: God commands us to believe in the name of His Son, Jesus Christ.
God commands us to love one another.
This is the commandment God gave us.

passages.scripture: Whoever keeps His commandments remains in God, and God in him. And by this we know that He remains in us: by the Spirit He has given us.

lines.text: Whoever keeps God's commandments remains in God.
And God remains in that person.
God has given us His Spirit.
Having God's Spirit is how we know that God remains in us.
